notes.title: FIT Food update
notes.content:
List of improvements:
1. Food data in CUBE RUN shown after clicking on a cube
2. Better feedback and explanations for players
3. Beginner levels now easier to play and advanced levels harder to win
4. Redesigned cards and panels
